title.narrative: Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment project (GEWE)

description.narrative: This Project Initiation Plan (PIP) aims at implementing several seeding initiatives during the critical period of January 2025 to June 2026 to help Viet Nam to achieve its national targets on women’s political participation. These initiatives are also designed to consolidate all UNDP’s efforts and strengthen the partnerships with national counterparts and development partners, that will enable UNDP to deliver more comprehensive and sustainable offers on promoting women’s political participation as well as the women, peace, and security agenda in Viet Nam.The two key interventions are to strengthen women’s political participation in elected bodies and enhance women’s meaningful participation in international and national peace and security efforts. To achieve these goals, the project will bolster national institutional capacity by supporting the Training Center for Elected Representatives (TCER) of the National Assembly to design and deliver gender-inclusive training modules. This support will enable TCER to provide specialized training for women deputies, empowering them to meaningfully engage in policy discussions, particularly in critical areas such as energy. Additionally, the project will serve as a strategic entry point for UNDP to support the Ministry of Defense in the implementation of the National Action Plan on Women, Peace and Security (NAP WPS) and will be catalytic to the elevation of their existing partnership. It will create the space, trust, and mechanisms for the longer-term provision of technical expertise and capacity-building on women empowerment, gender equality and evidence-based reforms, which will further enable the defence sector to advance the WPS agenda. The initiative aligns with UNDP’s broader efforts to promote women’s political participation and inclusive climate governance in Viet Nam.
